subject: I want to avoid extension names to appear in the dropdown menu.

messages.author: 862dcfdada8cc0b2
messages.subject: I want to avoid extension names to appear in the dropdown menu.
parts: I have a simple question here. I use selectInput() to choose a file from my "data" subdirectory which appears in a drop-down menu. I have files with .csv extension in the "data" subdirectory. I want to avoid .csv extension to appear with the file name in the dropdown menu. How to do?? Thanks

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: I want to avoid extension names to appear in the dropdown menu.
parts:
Hei,
  Remember always paste your source code here, so others know what are you talking and debug it.
  If I understand correctly, I thought you mixed the 'value' and 'text' of a selectInput box. 

  suppose you have a select input as follow: 

selectInput("myCSV", "Select CSV data:",
            c("dat1.csv", "dat2.csv"))

If you didn't specify names for your option, the default names are their values, if you don't want to show the extension, you can give each value a name: 
selectInput("myCSV", "Select CSV data:",
            c("A" = "dat1.csv", "dat2" = "dat2.csv"))

Hope this helpful to you.
